The '''Imperial Command Post''' was a military installation of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] located in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]] following the [[Invasion of Belsavis|prison break]]. It was a damaged [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex that the Empire took over in the [[Tusker Glade]].
